apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 164 (1.1.164) routes near-native streams with MetalFX enabled directly to the single-pass Metal 4 HDR renderer (NativeStreamMetal4HDRRenderer) when spatial upscaling is ineligible (e.g. 2560x1080 -> 2868x1320), eliminating the redundant 2-pass intermediate color conversion. Also fixes stage barrier dependencies in NativeStreamMetal4EffectsRenderer for passes without upscaling. Unsigned Release IPA for KravaSigner.
